'''Bin''' was a town on [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. At some point in or after [[94 BBY/Legends|94 BBY]], the [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] attacked it to avenge the [[Twenty-First Battle of Zehava]], despite being outnumbered and outgunned.
